build_VGG_CNN_M_1024_conv5_body: build a VGG CNN M 1024 conv5 body with conv, relu, LRN, and maxpool layers for feature extraction
build_VGG_CNN_M_1024_roi_fc_head: build a VGG CNN M 1024 ROI fully connected head with RoI feature transform and FC layers
review_add_VGG_CNN_M_1024_conv5_body: review the add_VGG_CNN_M_1024_conv5_body function that constructs a 5-layer convolutional body with gradient stopping on early layers
review_add_VGG_CNN_M_1024_roi_fc_head: review the add_VGG_CNN_M_1024_roi_fc_head function that adds RoI pooling and two FC layers for Fast R-CNN
summarize_VGG_CNN_M_1024: summarize the VGG CNN M 1024 model architecture from arXiv 1405.3531 used in Detectron for object detection
